svg.title: Backoff spends the original request deadline
svg.desc: An illustrative one-second budget starts at zero. A first error at 600ms plus a 100ms delay leaves 300ms, so a minimum 100ms attempt allowance can fit. A first error at 800ms plus a 200ms delay leaves no time and the retry must not start. Both cases have one original deadline and a two-attempt ceiling; admission cannot guarantee remote completion.

g.text: A retry does not reset the clock
Illustrative total budget: 1,000 ms; at most two attempts
Minimum 100 ms attempt allowance fits; recheck after backoff.
No time remains: stop instead of starting another attempt.
Eligibility, remaining spend and side-effect reconciliation are separate gates too.
